import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { area } from "../../../backend/schema/area";

export const areaCms = customizeTable<typeof area>("area", {
    display: {
        title: "comment"
    },
    sort: ["lastUpdated", "desc"],
    listFields: ["id", "name", "gid", "comment", "ended", "editsPending"],
    fields: {
        name: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastUpdated: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "name",
        "gid",
        "comment",
        "ended",
        "editsPending",
        "beginDateYear",
        "beginDateMonth",
        "beginDateDay",
        "endDateYear",
        "endDateMonth",
        "endDateDay",
        "lastUpdated",
        "typeRelation"
    ]
});
